shared_elements: horizontal register or band with repeated vertical strokes/ticks
linear low-relief / outline drawing with schematic bodies
repetition of similar motifs in a row
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic outline figures arranged in horizontal registers, and both include a band of repeated short vertical strokes (the comb-like row above the animals in A, the row of crew strokes along the hull in B), which is the closest correspondence. Otherwise the content is quite different: A shows profile quadrupeds, a bird with long neck, a snake-like form and abstract emblem-like boxes stacked in vertical panels, while B is dominated by large boats with upcurved prows carrying crew rows, with scattered tiny human figures — no boats in A, no animals or emblem panels in B.
